newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Petrobras an Omega buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Petrobras an Omega buy.

text.p: -- Brazilian investment bank Banco Omega said it was recommending common shares of state oil monopoly Petrobras despite their low liquidity.

-- It said in a report that a change in Petrobras' statutes will allow foreign investors to buy the firm's common shares after legislation regulating the opening of the oil sector to private investment is approved by Congress.
-- Omega also said the government, which owns 81.72 percent of Petrobras' capital, is willing to sell 31 percent and maintain the 51 percent stake necessary to remain its majority shareholder.
-- Petrobras common stock fell 1.84 percent to 133.50 reais at 1450 local time/1650 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
